source_title: Shareholders who sold shares of Skechers (NYSE: SKX) should contact Wolf Haldenstein Immediately
source_excerpt:
Lead Plaintiff Deadline December 21, 2026
NEW YORK , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wolf Haldenstein Adler Freeman & Herz LLP ("Wolf Haldenstein"), a nationally recognized securities litigation law firm, announces that a securities class action lawsuit has been filed in the United States District Court for the Central District of California against Skechers U.S.A., Inc. (NYSE: SKX ) ("Skechers" or the "Company") and certain of its officers and directors, as well as 3G Capital Partners L.P., Greenhill & Co., LLC and related defendants. The lawsuit was filed on behalf of all persons or entities that sold shares of Skechers Class A common stock from April 24, 2025 through September 12, 2025, including those who sold shares in the Going - Private acquisition of Skechers by 3G Capital Partners L.P. and its affiliates on September 12, 2025.
Investors who sold Skechers shares during the period noted above, may be eligible to participate in the case, with the lead-plaintiff deadline set for December 21, 2026.
PLEASE CLICK HERE TO SUBMIT CONTACT AND TRADE INFORMATION
The filed Complaint alleges that throughout the Class Period, Defendants made materially false and misleading statements and omitted material facts concerning Skechers Going-Private Acquisition in the April 24, 2025 Information Statement and related public reports. Specifically, the Complaint alleges that the Skechers Defendants:
falsely represented that the acquisition and the $63 per share consideration were fair;
made misleading statements about the mixed merger consideration and the impact of U.S. and China tariffs on the Company; and
misled investors about strategic alternatives and efforts to explore those alternatives.
This illustrious firm, founded in 1888, is steadfast in its pursuit of justice for investors who have suffered financial harm due to these misrepresented statements. The law firm brings to the fore over 125 years of legal expertise in securities litigation and has a proven record of protecting the rights of investors.
We encourage all investors who have been affected or have information that will assist in our investigation, to contact Wolf Haldenstein Adler Freeman & Herz LLP.
There is no cost or obligation to speak with an attorney.
Contact Person: Gregory Stone, Director of Case and Financial Analysis
Firm Website: Wolf Haldenstein Adler Freeman & Herz LLP
This press release may be considered Attorney Advertising in some jurisdictions under the applicable law and ethical rules.
